newsitem.title: SPAIN: France Telecom aims for Spain Airtel -press.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom aims for Spain Airtel -press.

text.p: France Telecom considers Spain's mobile operator Airtel has more growth potential that the planned second basic telephone operator Retevision, according to the firm's international development director Marc Dandelot.
Thursday's financial daily Expansion reported Dandelot saying; "our possible presence in Retevision we would consider as a door into Airtel, which has much more growth potential than Retevision".
Speaking exclusively to Spanish journalists, Dandelot said "Telefonica's main competitor in Spain is not Retevision but Airtel."
Separately, financial daily La Gaceta reported that France Telecom is waiting for Telefonica to clarify its position with British Telecom before presenting an offer for Retevision.
BT recently bought a 8.5 percent stake in Airtel.
